names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 10 марта ст. ст., «Руфин Кесарийский, мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off. «Кесарийский» is kept: it is the city the life page has the martyrs brought to, and it is the only epithet the calendar gives him.

death.note: The life page opens «пострадали во время гонения императора Деция (249–251) и его преемника Валериана (253–259)» and gives no year; the day's line says only «(III)». The interval is the two reigns the page names.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Кодрата Никомидийского, Саторина, Руфина, и прочих (III).»

attestations.note: The line's «и прочих» leaves the company open and the calendar gives only these three names; he is the second of the two beside Quadratus. Name page 1891 carries no life and lists no second day; the life is the day's own life605.htm, which is Quadratus's and names the two of them in one sentence. The day page prints no hymn at all.
